purpose: Seek agreement or frame an emphatic discovery.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Plain clause + ではないか; nouns generally omit predicate だ.
Is this not a good plan?
The train is already here, look.
Do we not need to think about it a little more?
formation: Plain clause + ではないか; nouns generally omit predicate だ.
restrictions: Can sound assertive or argumentative; polite intonation does not make every context gentle.
mistake: This rhetorical pattern often affirms the proposition rather than denying it.
